app_tagline: Offline Multilingual Assistant for Government Notices
banner_urgent: Urgent Deadlines Approaching in next 7 days!
drop_or_upload: Photograph or upload a government notice / letter
sample_notices: Or try with a sample notice:
analyzing: Gemma 4 reading notice (stamps, Kannada/Hindi tables, dates)...
thinking: Gemma 4 Thinking: Consulting rulebook & citizen charter...
legal_guidance_disclaimer: This is guidance, not legal advice. Verify at the concerned office.
voice_listening: Listening... Release to process with Gemma 4
voice_examples: Try asking: "What is this notice?", "When is my deadline?", "Add a reminder", "What documents do I need?"
consent_desc: Go Vision stores your profile and deadlines purely offline in a local SQLite database on your device. We mask Aadhaar and PAN numbers so only the last 4 digits are shown. No data is sent to the cloud.
data_deleted_success: All stored notices, deadlines, profile and checklist items have been wiped clean.
validate_id_desc: Verhoeff algorithm for 12-digit Aadhaar, PAN format, and IFSC. (Format validation only; never claims identity verification).
